title: Design System: Conformal LLM Router Console

body.purpose: Table rows, prose explanations, and specimen text blocks.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Triggers live inference or conformal risk evaluation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #1c2721; color: #fcfbf8; border: 1px solid #1c2721; border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2a3a31; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #236b52; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Synthetic Preview Toggle Button
components.description: Explicit global toggle for deterministic [Synthetic] sample telemetry.
components.css: .ds-btn-synthetic { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #fdf6e9; color: #8f520e; border: 1px solid #b46914; border-radius: 2px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-synthetic:hover { background: #faeccb; } .ds-btn-synthetic:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #236b52; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-synthetic-tag { padding: 1px 6px; border: 1px solid #dfb97d; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

components.name: PASS Decision Badge
components.description: Indicates conformal risk score below the calibrated alpha cutoff.
components.css: .ds-badge-pass { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; background: #e4f2ec; color: #1b5642; border: 1px solid #b6d9c9; border-radius: 2px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: ABSTAIN Decision Badge
components.description: Indicates MAPIE abstention when risk meets or exceeds threshold.
components.css: .ds-badge-abstain { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; background: #fbe9e7; color: #9e3829; border: 1px solid #e8beb8; border-radius: 2px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
The Conformal LLM Router console treats every inference trace, conformal calibration curve, and cost-quality trade-off like an inspectable laboratory specimen. Instead of dark neon observability chrome or generic slate-and-blue SaaS boxes, the workspace pairs a deep moss-charcoal navigation ledger with warm archival rag paper surfaces, crisp hairline boundaries, and tabular numerical precision.

Operating clarity drives every surface decision. Sliders for target risk `alpha` and cost weight `lambda_cost` sit immediately above the data view without mutating server defaults, empirical metrics remain visibly bound to their provenance (`Ready`, `TBD`, or `[Synthetic]`), and every verification claim exposes the underlying NLI, cosine, entity, and threshold signals inside the `EvidenceStrip`.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast split shell pairing a persistent `248px` deep moss rail with a warm archival rag workbench.
Flat, hairline-ruled specimen containers (`1px` stone borders, `2px`–`3px` corner radii) free of ambient drop shadows.
Strict evidence provenance distinguishing live SQLite telemetry, offline benchmark artifacts, `[TBD]` unrun stages, and `[Synthetic]` sample previews.
Tabular-numeral UI typography paired with monospace strictly for request identifiers, model strings, and calibrated statistical measurements.

rules.name: The Provenance Color Rule
rules.body: Amber (`synthetic-amber`) is reserved strictly for `[Synthetic]`, `[TBD]`, and `FALLBACK` states so reviewers never mistake fixture previews or degraded runs for verified production metrics.

rules.name: The AA Wash Contrast Rule
rules.body: Semantic pill text over tinted status washes must achieve at least 4.5:1 contrast (`conformal-abstain-ink` on `conformal-abstain-wash`, `conformal-pass-ink` on `conformal-pass-wash`).

rules.name: The Tabular Measurement Rule
rules.body: Every numeric KPI, table column, slider readout, and SVG axis tick enforces `tabular-nums` so interactive `(alpha, lambda_cost)` scrubbing never induces layout jitter.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Page and section headings speak directly without uppercase eyebrow labels placed above them.

rules.name: The Flat Hairline Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from surface tint and `1px` stone rules, never ambient shadows or `>1px` accent borders on cards or alerts.

dos: Do keep `alpha` (`0.01`–`0.30`) and `lambda_cost` (`0.00`–`1.00`) controls strictly synchronized with SVG chart operating markers and API query parameters.
Do mark every unrun offline artifact metric explicitly as `TBD` with its backend reason string, and attach `[Synthetic]` badges whenever sample fixtures are enabled.
Do preserve `1px` hairline borders and flat tonal separation across all panels, empty states, and inspector panes.
Do theme native browser surfaces (`::selection`, `caret-color`, `:focus-visible`, scrollbars, range inputs, and `tabular-nums`) from the archival palette.
donts: Don't place uppercase kickers or eyebrows above headings, or render nested bordered cards inside `.specimen-panel` containers.
Don't use `>1px` colored left/right border stripes on navigation links, callouts, cards, or alerts.
Don't substitute Unicode glyphs or emojis for the stroke-`1.75` SVG icon set, or use body/UI text smaller than `12px` (`11px` floor strictly for compact pills/labels).
Don't fabricate live telemetry or hide `Gateway Unreachable` / `503` errors when FastAPI is offline or missing artifacts.
